textual.context: Promotional discussion by the speaker of a marketing platform for Bitcoin and BitClub Network; the ASR does not establish whether the stated follower growth or commissions occur as described.
textual.potential_relevance: A recurring payment is linked to claimed audience-growth results and a commission for referring additional people, which may warrant later assessment of the stated return, referral structure, and conditions.
textual.limitations: The source records do not provide platform terms, payment records, the identity of recipients, or independent confirmation of follower growth or commission payments.

textual.observation: The speaker links use of the platform to recruiting people into BitClub Network, stating that one recruited person could offset the annual platform cost and that increased sharing would grow mining pools as more people join.

evidence.quote: If that helps you get one person in Bit Club network and for the entire year has paid itself off
which will result in your mining pools growing and growing bigger and bigger because more people are coming on board because you're saving time using stage.

textual.context: The statements are made as promotional claims about marketing efficiency and recruitment, rather than as an independently verified outcome.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed recovery of a platform cost is expressly connected to bringing a person into BitClub Network, and the platform is presented as a means to increase participation in mining pools.
textual.limitations: The records do not state the terms of BitClub Network participation, any actual mining-pool outcomes, or whether recruitment produces the claimed financial result.

textual.observation: The speaker says users can set up a Coinbase wallet through the page and states that the speaker receives ten dollars per person.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker actively promotes a recruitment-dependent BitClub Network opportunity and markets a paid platform by claiming that recruiting one person can pay for the service and that commissions make it free after three or four members. He presents team expansion and bringing in new members as the path to growing mining pools, then directly asks viewers to contact him to get set up.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the speaker describes an existing team and member structure in which earnings and fee recovery depend on bringing additional people into BitClub Network. The stated $3 commission per person and the claim that three or four members make the service free connect the benefit directly to recruitment rather than to an ordinary one-level product referral.
